verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into a fresh Blinding Dart or let Teemo poke you from range uncontested; you win every time you land Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) or E (Jousting) to force a trade right after his Q goes on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Teemo has no escape tool besides passive movement speed from W (Move Quick), so once Kled closes distance with Q's 800-range hook or E's 550-range dash, Teemo is stuck trading at melee range where he loses. The entire lane is gated by Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) on its 8s cooldown — while it's up he can blind your autos mid-trade and walk away; while it's down, your Violent Tendencies burst wins the fight outright.

theirWindow.when: Teemo just landed Q on you
theirWindow.what: Your autos are blinded for its duration — don't commit a W (Violent Tendencies) burst into this, it will whiff. Back off or use E (Jousting) to dash past him instead of trading autos.

yourWindow.when: Teemo's Q is on its 8s cooldown
yourWindow.what: Hook him with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) to yank him in, then pop W (Violent Tendencies) immediately — he has nothing to stop four empowered attacks until his blind comes back up.

powerCurve.note: Teemo pokes free before your E unlocks
Teemo's R mushrooms zone your all-ins

start.why: Teemo's entire laning pattern is ranged poke with Toxic Shot autos and Blinding Dart chip damage — Doran's Shield posts the higher measured win rate (52% over 25 games) because the regen directly answers that harass pattern, where Doran's Blade (45.7% over 35 games) doesn't.

boots.why: 54.5% win rate over 55 games and 78.6% pick rate — the magic resist blunts Toxic Shot's poison-over-time and Noxious Trap's cloud damage, both magic sources.

core.why: First item in the highest-performing measured path (62.5% over 8 games); the bonus health and wave-clear let you force fights without caring about poison chip damage.
Second item in that same 62.5% path — scales your side-lane pressure once you've established the solo-kill lead.
Closes out the 62.5%-win-rate path with sustain and damage that offsets Teemo's poison DOT in extended skirmishes.

situational.when: fights are dragging out and you need the armor shred to finish him before he kites to a wall
you're getting burst down in all-ins before your damage lands
you're ahead on kills and want to snowball the early solo-kill advantage into a pick-off item

runes.keystoneWhy: 59.1% win rate at 27.9% pick — Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage rewards exactly the extended, forced melee fights you're trying to create by hooking Teemo in with Q.

summoners.why: 51.8% win rate at 71.8% pick — Ignite converts your Q-hook all-ins into kills against a squishy ranged target, locking in the solo-kill advantage the data already shows you have.

playing.title: All-in right after his Q lands
playing.detail: Once Teemo uses Blinding Dart, it's down for 8 seconds with no replacement escape besides passive movement speed. Hook with Q and dump W (Violent Tendencies) in that window.

playing.title: Never auto-trade while blinded
playing.detail: Blind nullifies your attacks outright. If you're blinded mid-fight, disengage with E (Jousting)'s dash-back instead of standing in autos that will miss.

playing.title: Close distance with Q, not autos
playing.detail: Bear Trap on a Rope has 800 range and yanks him to you — use it to open every trade rather than walking up, since Teemo's 680-range poke punishes a slow approach.

playing.title: Check bushes for mushrooms before diving
playing.detail: From level 6 on, Teemo's R (Noxious Trap) can be pre-placed in jungle entrances and bushes on a 1s cooldown. Stepping on one slows you and telegraphs your all-in.

playing.title: Keep trades short
playing.detail: Toxic Shot poisons on every Teemo auto and stacks damage over time. A quick hook-W-burst kill beats a drawn-out fight where his poison outlasts your damage window.

playing.title: Reset with E's return dash
playing.detail: Jousting can be recast to dash back through your target — use it to exit a fight the instant your W burst ends instead of lingering in poison DOT range.

playing.title: Don't force R (Chaaaaaaaarge) for a lane kill
playing.detail: At 110-140s cooldown, your ultimate is a map-wide engage tool, not a lane finisher — save it for picking off Teemo elsewhere once he's isolated.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade-timing and cooldown-window reasoning above is my own tactical read of the ability kits, not sourced from the data.
